Name: Be My Valentine
Author: Taskmaster2
Description:
[b]Be My Valentine[/b] adds heartfelt, lore‑friendly letters to Stardew Valley’s Winter 14th Festival of Love.  In year 1 and year 2, bachelor or bachelorette you have met will send a unique Valentine cards to the player, unless you are married.  If you’re married, for year 2 or 3, your spouse may send a special letter, making the day feel even more personal.  This MOD does not impact years 4 or after, so meant for new play throughs.

Features:
[list]
[*]Distinct Valentine’s letters from the bachelors and bachelorettes (Year 1 and  2) on 15 new, pixel art Valentine's stationery
[*]Exclusive spouse letter if married (Year 2 and 3)
[*]Character‑consistent writing, ESRB‑safe and immersion‑friendly
[*]Three to five unique letters per villager, per year 1 and 2, so you have to play multiple times to receive them all
[*]No gift giving to impact game balance
[/list]Celebrate Winter 14th with letters that grow alongside your relationships — whether you’re dating, married, or just enjoying the charm of Pelican Town. 

From the author of Junk Mail and Monthly Mail... it seems mail is my MOD theme.  I hope you enjoy it!
